## Virtual environment and code style instructions

The virtual environment can be activated by

```bash
micromamba activate codit
```

# Structure of the codebase

The codebase is structured as follows:

- `my_scripts/`: This directory contains all the scripts that are used for data processing, analysis, and visualization. It is organized into subdirectories based on the type of task (e.g., `data_processing`, `figures`, etc.).
- `notebooks/`: This directory contains Jupyter notebooks that are used for exploratory data analysis, prototyping, and documentation. Each notebook should be named descriptively to indicate its purpose.
- `src/`: This directory contains the source code for the project, including any modules or packages that are developed as part of the project. It should be organized in a way that reflects the structure of the project and makes it easy to navigate.
